entities.name: Azerbaijan State Museum of Musical Culture
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Azerbaijan State Museum of Musical Culture was opened in 1967, in Baku. The goal of the museum is the collection, storage, investigation and popularization of materials related to the musical history of Azerbaijan.
